title: Blackout
profTagline: An endless night city in 3D: run, vault, punch and grab coins while the Blackout kills the lights behind you.
howto: Joystick on the left — run. Crates and cars across the lane are vaulted by themselves. The key on the right punches green dumpsters for coins. The dark behind you never sleeps.
skinsHint: Coins from the runs buy new runners. Tap to buy and wear.
installDesc: Add it to your home screen to launch it like a game.
installIosHint: In Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: Pick “Install app” in the browser menu.
